brand_notes: Emit series (2021+) is Dynaudio entry range: Emit 10 (14 cm, 6 Ω, $799), Emit 20 (18 cm MSP, 6 Ω, $1,049), shared 28 mm Cerotar tweeter with Hexis; 1st-order tweeter/2nd-order woofer crossover. Sensitivity claimed 86 dB for Emit 10 and 20. Emit 10 has no Tier A/B data for the current model (only older Emit M10). (mfr-dynaudio-emit-20, eac-dynaudio-emit-20)
takeaways: Sensitivity computed 83.2 dB vs 86 dB claimed (2.8 dB shortfall).
LW ±2.6 dB, f3 52 Hz, wide directivity; woofer resonance near 700 Hz muffles mids (Erin).
Min impedance 5.5 Ω (no flag for 6 Ω); EPDR 2.9 Ω.
THD ~0.8% at 86 dB, ~2.4% at 96 dB (graph-read); compression mild except 700 Hz resonance (-2.2 dB at 102 dB).
Critics positive (WHF Sound 4, Audiograde Best Value); only 1 user report, anecdotal.
conflicts: Sensitivity 86 dB claimed vs 83.2 dB computed
Aim: Erin prefers off-axis; What Hi-Fi? found toe-in helped
